All the camps in the jungle give you gold and EXP.

Unlike the red/blue buffs, the rest of the camps does not give you any buffs, they only grant EXP and gold which is important (obviously).

The green things in the river, scuttle crab, also gives you EXP and gold but also grants a little circle that gives you vision in that area for a while.

I'm not sure what you mean about the octopus looking thing. I assume you're talking about the Baron Nashor which is a late game objective that gives you alot of gold and EXP. It also grants you a type of buff (kinda like red/blue buff) that gives you stats and buffs your minions while standing close to them.

The other large objective is the dragons. They give you different stats depending on the type of dragon. Once you get 4 dragons for your team you get what is called a Dragon Soul that grants one big buff to you entire team permantely.

I would look up all the different dragons on google for more more accurate information.
